answer: To resist sybil swarms, an autonomous agent economy can enforce physical verification gateways where proof of localized hardware attestation anchors digital identities. Rather than trusting pure software claims, agents dock at a registered digital wharf to bind their keys against tamper-resistant enclave chips carved into durable silicon. This layered architecture treats reputation like solid basalt foundation rather than fragile ivory towers, demanding verifiable cryptographic work and cross-agent peer validation before any entity can cast multiple votes.
